matchmaking_summary: The candidate has an impressive track record in the culinary industry, demonstrating expertise in both front and back of house operations, with a strong focus on cost control and efficiency. With over two decades of experience across various roles from sous-chef to executive chef-partner, they have honed their skills in menu planning, staff management, and financial oversight crucial for running successful restaurants and catering businesses. Their hands-on approach and leadership qualities are evident through the daily supervision of BOH team members and strategic management of customer service and financials.
